integrity: Proof is analytic; exact symbolic checks and finite simulations supplement but do not establish it. Distinct forward box distribution and billiard laws acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Exact population-moment theorem for full-dimensional Euclidean rectangular boxes only. Does not cover skew parallelepipeds, alternate point measures, or statistical noise. Complete historical priority has not been independently established.
title: Sharp three-moment inverse and conditional volume envelope for rectangular boxes
